5. Learned counsel for the N.H.A.I. submits that the award has already been prepared in this case and the only remedy available to the petitioner to file application before the Arbitrator under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956, [48 of 1956].

In this background, the petitioner is directed to file an application under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956 before the Divisional Commissioner-cum-Arbitrator, Patna for enhancement of his claim and the Divisional Commissioner-cum-Arbitrator, Patna is directed to consider the claim of the petitioner on the basis of the documents provided by him and as well as the price and market value of the area.
7. It is directed to dispose of the application of the petitioner within nine months from the date of filing.
